notes: PactoTech Control Test 20260919_0255 (earlytesting): stand-alone full-screen input tester. Dino battle: a tiny dinosaur per controller appears when you touch it and fights the others with every button (A jump, B fireball, X bite, Y tail spin, LB roar, RB charge, LT shield, RT run, START taunt, BACK egg, GUIDE hide); mice, trackballs and light guns shoot with their crosshair. Switch it off in the settings if you want a plain tester. Mode-input pin states next to the arcade panel (firmware 20260919 or newer).
